tasks.label: CUDA: Compilar y Ejecutar
tasks.command: call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" && nvcc -I common -L "${workspaceFolder}\lib" "${file}" -o "${workspaceFolder}\build\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" && set "PATH=${workspaceFolder}\bin;%PATH%" && "${workspaceFolder}\build\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe"
